intro: Your name, how you sign in, appearance, language and time zone. Each change saves straight away.
name: Name
youNote: Atlas shows your name on the account button and in its menus. The agents never see it.
lookNote: System follows this Mac, and switches when it does.
langSub: Arabic turns the whole app right to left.
tzSub: Every time in Atlas shows in this zone.
currencySub: Atlas shows every amount in US dollars.
previewSub: Dates follow the language. Figures look the same in both.
teamSame: The team keeps Baghdad time, the same clock as yours.
teamBehind: The team keeps Baghdad time. {{city}} is {{span}} behind, so the watchlist reaches you at {{time}}.
teamAhead: The team keeps Baghdad time. {{city}} is {{span}} ahead, so the watchlist reaches you at {{time}}.

e.offline: Couldn’t save. Atlas’s server didn’t answer, so it’s back to {{was}}.

err.title: Couldn’t load your preferences
err.body: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running with ./atlas up, then try again.

zp.title: Time zone
zp.search: Search a city, country or offset
zp.none: No time zone matches “{{q}}”. Try a city, a country or an offset like +4.

dl.sr: When the team works, in {{city}} time

tf.name: Two-factor sign-in
tf.offSub: Off. Atlas asks only for your password.
tf.onSub: On since {{date}}. After your password, Atlas asks for a code from your authenticator app.
tf.left_one: 1 of 8 left. It signs you in once, without your phone.
tf.left_other: {{count}} of 8 left. Each one signs you in once, without your phone.
tf.lowBody: Make new ones before you run out. The codes you have now stop working when you do.
tf.noneBody: If you lose your phone, you can’t sign in. Make new codes now.
tf.liveBody: Turn on two-factor sign-in, so your password alone can’t open Atlas.
tf.noteOff: Two-factor sign-in asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone after your password, so a stolen password isn’t enough to get in.
tf.noteOnBefore: Lost your phone and your codes? On this Mac, run
tf.s1Text: Enter your Atlas password to continue.
tf.s2Title: Scan this code with your authenticator app
tf.s2l1: Open an authenticator app on your phone, such as the Passwords app, Google Authenticator or 1Password.
tf.s2l2: Add an account, then scan this QR code.
tf.key: Can’t scan? Type this setup key instead.
tf.s3Text: If your phone isn’t with you, each code signs you in once. Atlas shows them only now.
tf.certFile: Keep these somewhere safe, away from your phone.
tf.onToastBody: Next time you sign in, Atlas asks for a code from your app.
tf.offText: Atlas will ask only for your password. The code in your authenticator app and your recovery codes stop working.
tf.offToastBody: Atlas asks only for your password now.
tf.rgText: You get 8 new codes, and every code you have now stops working.
tf.rgToastBody: Your old codes no longer work.
tf.eCode: That code didn’t match. Type the code your app shows now.
tf.eMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
tf.eOffline: Atlas’s server didn’t answer. Check that Atlas is running, then try again.
tf.copiedBody: Paste them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
tf.qrAlt: QR code to add Atlas to your authenticator app
